title: Silk on the Road
summary: Spiders have strung the road with silk and something is waiting in it. Pell wants the road open and the nest cleared.
ask: Pell: Stop. Not that way. Look up.
Pell: The trees are strung together with silk, and the thing that strung them is still in there. I carry letters, I'm not paid to be eaten. Can you clear it?

steps.text: Clear the spiders off the road
start: Something small drops out of the branches. Then something bigger.
done: Pell: That's the ones I could see. The nest will be further in.

steps.text: Find where the silk comes from
done: A hollow among the roots, wrapped like a parcel. It is very quiet in here.

steps.text: Deal with what is guarding it
start: The silk shivers. Whatever is in it knows you are here.
done: It is done. The silk goes slack and the road behind you is open again.

steps.text: Tell Pell the road is clear
done: Pell: Clear? All of it? I'll take that on faith, and a little extra for the faith.
Pell: Here. Don't spend it all in one town.
